name: second-opinion
description: /second-opinion asks Fable (or the model you set) for a candid senior review of your recent commits, branch, uncommitted diff or a plan file, in the background without switching the session's model. Each run is one paid model call against your usage; the review opens in a pane, is saved under ~/.claude/second-opinions/, and can be handed to Claude with your next prompt.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model id or alias that writes the second opinion. Every /second-opinion run makes one call to it, billed to your usage.

effort.title: Reviewer effort
effort.description: How hard the reviewer thinks: higher is slower and uses more of your usage.

maxContextChars.title: Context cap (characters)
maxContextChars.description: The most git log, diff, status and file text sent with one review; larger sections are cut to fit.
